{{Quote|Usually I'm just a supplier. But I'll do anything to see a deal through.|Olok|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Olok''', known as '''Olok the Shadow''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Olok's products included trip mines from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], turrets built by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], neurotoxins from [[Quesh]], and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Olok arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darvannis]] to sell his wares to the gathering [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Army/Legends|armies]], turning the [[Oasis City Spaceport]] into a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] expo. During an [[Battle of Darvannis|attack]] on Darvannis, Olok was [[Death/Legends|slain]] despite the aid of his activated battle droids.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Olok the Shadow appears as the fifth boss in the "Scum and Villainy" Operation, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2012]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'',<ref name="TOR" /> and defeating Olok in various difficulty modes rewards players with painting-like trophies of Olok for use in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']].<ref name="GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>
